bio.text: he alone, although born among inept craftsmen, by the gift of God revived that art, which had come to a grievous pass, and brought it to such a form as could be called good.

source.author: Giorgio Vasari
source.title: Life of Giotto, in Lives of the Most Eminent Painters, Sculptors and Architects (trans. Gaston du C. de Vere)

bio.text: the innovations of Giotto consisted in the introduction, A, of gayer or lighter colours; B, of broader masses; and, C, of more careful imitation of nature than existed in the works of his predecessors.

source.author: John Ruskin
source.title: Giotto and his Works in Padua
